finding.summary: A duplicate takeover request is correctly rejected without external replay but advances fence epoch 1 to 2 without updating the active takeover generation. The later valid handoff calls reopen(1), receives false at epoch 2, and leaves automatic admission permanently fenced.
finding.evidence: Durable control committed manager/control_wait at lifecycle generation 5; review and send stay zero; lifecycle focused test fails at the expected fence-clear assertion.

passing_new_schedules: New intent before and after reopen both remain fenced through their own takeover and reopen only after their own handoff; action counts remain zero until then and become tick 1/send 1 afterward.

checks.residue: zero relevant process or temporary residue
checks.excluded: full/live G3, scripted/external OMP and reboot not run
